templates.name: homepage
templates.description: Global homepage: welcome stage, product-area gateway carousel, region/location selector, 'More about Continental' teaser rows, and Trending Stories card grid.

templates.name: car-landing
templates.description: Car & Van product landing page: promo stage, 'Find your tire' CTA, vehicle-type card grid, product carousel, technologies teaser, smart tips card grid, and 'Why Continental' quality-promise grid.

templates.name: product-search
templates.description: Tire finder entry page: 'How would you like to search?' mode chooser with Search by size / Search by vehicle options and Skip to results.

templates.name: search-results
templates.description: Product listing page (PLP): filter panel (vehicle type, OEM, additional filters) plus a grid of Continental car/4x4/van tire product cards.

templates.name: search-by-size
templates.description: Search-by-size page: heading, instructions, and a static tire-size input form (width, aspect ratio, diameter, speed/load index) with Back/Show results controls.

templates.name: search-by-vehicle
templates.description: Search-by-vehicle page: heading, instructions, and a static vehicle-selection form (brand, model, year, version, fitment) with Back/Show results controls.
